name: Safety & Peace
description: Protection from violent crime, traffic danger, terrorism, armed conflicts, natural disaster vulnerability, and organised crime.

name: Governance & Rule of Law
description: Control of public graft, predictable contract enforcement, civil service effectiveness, and physical/intellectual property rights.

name: Civil Liberties & Inclusion
description: Press freedom, liberal democracy checks, religious freedom, LGBTQ+ equality, women's peace & security, and academic freedom.

name: Economy, Labour & Living Costs
description: Domestic purchasing power, industrial complexity, income equality, workers' union rights, work-life balance & leisure, and housing affordability.

name: Health, Well-being & Family
description: Healthy lifespan (HALE), universal healthcare coverage (UHC), child welfare and family protections, and educational attainment.

name: Infrastructure, Transit & Tech
description: High-speed broadband download speeds, trade & transport logistics, universal internet penetration, and walkable public transit access.

name: Climate, Ecology & Environment
description: Bioclimatic comfort (Holiday Climate Index - HCI), clean ambient air (low PM2.5), safely managed drinking water, and climate change adaptation readiness.
